content.text: Digital creators in Nigeria, Ghana, and Kenya struggle to receive payments for their ebooks, courses, and digital products due to the unavailability of Stripe and Gumroad. Building a sovereign commerce infrastructure using Cloudflare Workers and NOWPayments offers a solution to this problem by providing a seamless and reliable payment experience for creators in restricted regions. This guide walks you through the process of setting up NOWPayments webhooks with Cloudflare Workers to get your store live and start processing transactions in a matter of hours. With the Edge Commerce Stack, you can deploy a complete commerce infrastructure in 48 hours, including Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, with 5 products loaded and SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured. By following this guide, you can break free from platform restrictions and start selling your digital products confidently. This guide is specifically designed for creators who need a reliable and sovereign commerce infrastructure to succeed in the digital marketplace.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Platforms like Stripe and Gumroad often impose restrictions on creators in certain regions, making it difficult for them to receive payments for their digital products. In contrast, building a sovereign commerce infrastructure using Cloudflare Workers and NOWPayments allows creators to maintain full control over their payments and data, without relying on third-party platforms. This approach also offers greater flexibility and scalability, enabling creators to adapt to changing market conditions and grow their business with confidence.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To set up NOWPayments webhooks with Cloudflare Workers, you will need to create an account with NOWPayments and obtain your API keys. You will also need to have a Cloudflare account and set up a new Workers project. Additionally, you will need to have a Supabase account and set up a new database to store your order data. By having all the necessary tools and accounts in place, you can deploy your infrastructure quickly and efficiently.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you will need to configure your NOWPayments account to accept payments in your preferred cryptocurrency. You will also need to set up your Cloudflare Workers project to trigger a webhook event whenever a payment is received. This will enable you to automate the delivery of your digital products to your customers, ensuring a seamless and reliable experience.
You can start processing transactions in a matter of hours with the Edge Commerce Stack.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you have set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you can go live and start processing transactions. To do this, you will need to deploy your Cloudflare Workers project and configure your NOWPayments account to trigger a webhook event whenever a payment is received. You will also need to test your infrastructure to ensure that it is working correctly and that payments are being processed smoothly.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Scaling your infrastructure is a critical step in ensuring that your business can grow and adapt to changing market conditions. To scale your infrastructure, you will need to monitor your performance metrics and adjust your configuration as needed. You may also need to add more resources to your Cloudflare Workers project or upgrade your NOWPayments plan to handle increased traffic.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

Getting paid in crypto is operationally simpler than it appears. You configure your wallet address in NOWPayments once — this takes under 30 minutes. From that point, every sale deposits automatically into your wallet without any action required from you. The transaction hash in your order log is cryptographic proof of every payment. When you want to convert to local currency, you transfer USDT from your wallet to your exchange account and post a P2P sell order. The buyer sends local currency to your bank account or mobile money account and you release the USDT. Most P2P transactions complete in under 30 minutes. The entire process from sale to local currency in your account is faster than waiting for Gumroad's weekly payout to process.
